title: It from Bit via Gödel
description:
A work-in-progress snapshot. Nothing here is a finished result.

A multi-paper series deriving Standard Model structure, the quantum postulates, and spacetime dimensionality from self-reference and computability. Paper 1 covers foundations; Paper 2 derives spacetime from the FANOUT boundary.

This archive holds the LaTeX sources, the Zotero-exported bibliographies, the supporting computations, machine-checked Lean 4 proofs of several of Paper 1's theorem-like statements, and an archive of the research conversations from which the work developed — including the routes that failed.

Every claim in the corpus carries one of six status labels — ESTABLISHED, STRUCTURAL, CANDIDATE, CONJECTURE, RHYME, OPEN — and the distinction matters: much of the material is explicitly conjectural or is a fenced analogy, and some citations are recorded as unverified. See ORIENTATION.md for what each body of text is worth before relying on any part of it.

Two licences by kind of material: CC BY 4.0 for the prose, figures and everything under knowledge/; MIT for scripts/ and notebooks/. Third-party LaTeX templates keep their own licences.
